_comment: Robinhood Chain testnet (46630) deployment parameters for script/DeployTestnet.s.sol.
PROVENANCE: docs/TESTNET-PLAN.md §1 and §3, and the verified venue table in
This file is DOCUMENTATION of the values the script compiles in as named constants.
The script does NOT read it: a Foundry script parsing JSON for safety-critical
immutables adds a failure mode (a silent key typo yields zero) for no benefit, and
every value here is immutable at the vault anyway. Keep the two in sync by review.
Addresses are NOT here - they are outputs, written to deployments/46630.json.

env.DEPLOYER_PK: deploys the simulators, CapacityOracle, CertFactory and both vaults
env.GOV_PK: deploys SolvencyRegistry and both CertOracles (checklist §4) and runs the governance phase
env.ATTESTER_PK: runs attest() and setMarkPrice(); never deploys anything
env.BATCH_KEEPER: REQUIRED. Address (not a key) the BatchAdvancer keeper signs with; registered as LighterSim.keeper in phase 5. Zero aborts the run with DeployTestnet_MissingBatchKeeper, and it must be distinct from all three senders
env.COMMIT: optional; recorded in the address book so the EIP-170 size claim stays checkable. Passed as an env var rather than shelled out because ffi is deliberately off
env._collateralNote: COLLATERAL and TEST_FAUCET are NOT read. The script deploys its own 6-decimal TestUSDG and its TestFaucet in _phase1_simulators() and mints both floats itself; there is no way to point it at a collateral token it did not deploy. A mainnet script would take the real USDG as an injected address instead - see the contract NatSpec.
